name: YVenture
tagline: Steps a founder from rough idea to first hires in short ordered passes
description: Bring a rough idea and it moves through the sequence a young company actually faces: choosing an entity, sharpening positioning, planning a first go-to-market push and working out who to hire first. Each stage returns a handful of concrete steps rather than an essay, read through a YC-and-Zero-to-One lens.
author: kittenworth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
